scope: paired training-only intervention, all twelve classes; no literature reproduction
hypothesis: SE gain2 may reduce delayed learning associated with initial attenuation; not established
intervention: all six SE outputs multiplied by fixed gain throughout training; weight tensors, initialization, optimizer, data and order identical
primary: final training loss and accuracy at step400; paired result for one seed, no statistical superiority claim
secondary: first step at training accuracy>=0.5 and >=0.9, if reached
stopping: fixed horizon, no early stopping or best-checkpoint selection
decision: If gain2 improves final loss/accuracy, replicate on further predefined seeds before larger training. If only onset improves, do not call remaining classification solved. If neither memorizes, examine remaining representation/optimization limitations; do not launch an arbitrary hyperparameter search.
limitations: gain acts throughout training, not only at initialization
effective input-dependent gates range0..2 instead of0..1
no isolated proof of original training-collapse cause
checkpoint_requirement: SE gain is graph configuration, not a tensor; serialize se_gain and architecture tag alongside state_dict
initial_activation_probe: one first selected example per class, same balanced twelve in both cases
